decisionQuestion: What are the most important next investigations that could shift the programme and are doable or worth doing?
decisionPrinciple: Prioritize bounded investigations that can derive the global Schur ray, establish radiative stability, construct the typed physical embedding, or kill one of those possibilities cleanly.
centralGate: Does the actual physical Pati-Salam carrier force one global Schur ray, and is its determinantal ideal preserved by quantum corrections?

investigations.title: Actual minimal Pati-Salam aggregate intertwiner and primitive-path census
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It decides whether the common Schur ray exists in the physical carrier or only in a toy typed category.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: A sourced representation-and-vertex inventory plus a verifier constructing the aggregate coupling matrix and all of its minors.
investigations.positiveResult: Only one physical packet exists or all admitted columns factor through one common morphism.
investigations.negativeResult: Two required carriers supply independent columns, making exact protection non-generic in the minimal embedding.

investigations.title: Complex-phase and indefinite-weight Schur-locus classification
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It closes the largest explicit caveat in the common-ray theorem or reveals a distinct symmetry-stable cancellation mechanism.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: A symbolic stratification of the two- and three-packet determinant-zero locus with transverse perturbation tests.
investigations.positiveResult: Every symmetry-stable component is common-ray factorization and nonaligned zeros are tuned.
investigations.negativeResult: An available reality, CP, or representation constraint enforces a nonaligned component.

investigations.title: One-loop and RG tangency of the Schur determinantal ideal
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It distinguishes a technically natural invariant manifold from a tree-level cancellation destroyed by counterterms.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: One frozen mediator Lagrangian, complete one-loop operator census, and symbolic test that beta(I) lies in the packet-and-minor ideal.
investigations.positiveResult: The matching variety is invariant under the one-loop flow.
investigations.negativeResult: A loop generates a transverse primitive leakage coefficient.

investigations.title: Formal typed matching category or superconnection
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It determines whether primitive/composite provenance and complete Schur packets form a consistent mathematical middle.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: A finite presented category and matrix matching functor with associativity, integration-order, real-structure, grading, and topology closure tests.
investigations.positiveResult: Composition preserves the packet ideal and realizes relation-sheet parity as a defined categorical symmetry.
investigations.negativeResult: Matching depends on elimination order or conflicts with the real-even physical module.

investigations.title: Bounded finite real-even embedding search
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: A complete witness would promote the construction, while a certified bounded no-go would identify the incompatible axioms.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: A versioned SAT/SMT/ILP or exhaustive constraint schema with declared bounds and checkable witness or UNSAT output.
investigations.positiveResult: A physical KO-6 Pati-Salam carrier satisfies support, reality, chirality, parity, and common-ray constraints.
investigations.negativeResult: No carrier exists within the declared bounds and a minimal incompatible constraint subset is isolated.

investigations.title: Jordan and Spin(2,3) aggregate multiplicity-one theorem or counterexample
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It could derive the common ray from representation theory or prove that current symmetry data permit multiple directions.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: A Hom-space decomposition for the physical aggregate domain and codomain fixed by priority 1.
investigations.positiveResult: The aggregate intertwiner occurs with multiplicity one.
investigations.negativeResult: At least two independent intertwiners occur.

investigations.title: Loop and multi-mediator matching with momentum-dependent form factors
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It tests whether finite packet provenance survives when matching becomes nonlocal and functional.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: One complete loop topology matched to a momentum-dependent kernel and a functional-rank closure test.
investigations.positiveResult: A closed functional packet ideal survives.
investigations.negativeResult: Momentum dependence creates unavoidable independent directions.

investigations.title: Direct correlated NuFIT electron-zero likelihood profile
investigations.whyProgrammeShifting: It can sharpen phenomenological viability but cannot derive the missing mechanism.
investigations.firstExecutableArtifact: A full four-variable evaluator or a collaboration-produced constrained likelihood profile.
investigations.positiveResult: A statistically resolved allowed or excluded texture region.
investigations.negativeResult: The texture is excluded by the joint profile.
dependencies: joint NuFIT evaluator or direct collaboration profile

deprioritized.reason: Claims 1489 and 1507 close the relevant ordinary U(1) and field-Z2 composition route.
It measures capacity before deriving the source and repeats the non-predictive saturation diagnosed in claims 1487-1488.
No ordinary field symmetry has been constructed; a genuine physical or categorical lift must come first.
The carrier, functor, phase-locus, and RG tests can reject the branch at much lower cost.
Spin(2,3), Golay, Leech, theology, dreams, and altered-state motifs remain admissible signposts but need an explicit intertwiner, transport law, or kill test before another tranche.
New sources should be ingested only when mapped to one of the decisive gates or when they alter the dependency frontier.

immediateTranche: complex and indefinite Schur-locus symbolic classifier
verdict: First determine whether the physical Pati-Salam inventory forces one global Schur ray; if it survives the complex-locus audit, test whether its ideal is tangent to the one-loop flow before expanding the programme.
